notes: The mappings cite the pinned HLAfederation roster attribute and encoding definitions in the IEEE 1516.2-2025 standard MIM. Installed-package results are bounded provider evidence and do not establish provider-independent conformance.

requirements.statement: The standard HLAfederation MOM class has one RTI-registered instance per federation execution and responds to attribute value requests through the ordinary instance-attribute update mechanism. The scenario discovers that instance and requests HLAfederatesInFederation using the public attribute-value update service.

HLAfederatesInFederation is a required, reliable, receive-order conditional attribute whose update condition is federate join or resign. Its contents identify the federates currently joined to the execution. The scenario checks the initial roster, the conditional roster after a new federate joins, and the conditional roster after that federate resigns.

requirements.source_symbol: HLAfederateReferenceList is a dynamic HLAvariableArray of HLAfederateReference; HLAfederateReference is represented by HLAfederateHandle; HLAfederateHandle is a dynamic HLAvariableArray of HLAbyte
requirements.statement: The standard MIM defines the roster as an order-unspecified dynamic array of federate references, with each reference represented by an encoded HLAfederateHandle. The scenario decodes each nested standard array and converts it through RTIambassador::decodeFederateHandle before comparing membership without assuming list order.
